newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it set its seven day repo at an unchanged 4.10 percent.
The decision was in line with expectations, a Reuter poll ahead of the announcement showed.
All primary dealers are invited to leave bids to the Riksbank by 0900 GMT on March 25 at the latest.
The lowest accepted volume was 200 million crowns and the highest accepted volume 40 billion crowns, the Riksbank said.
